This '''unidentified star''' was a dim [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Star/Legends|star]] located barely beyond the edge of the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]].<ref name="THG" /> It was a companion star to [[Y'Toub]], the primary star of the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA" /> This star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by [[Nar Hekka]], the outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Y'Toub system.<ref name="THG" />
